question: Are the focused SQLite migration tests sufficient upgrade evidence, or must this PR show a real Wrangler D1 upgrade run before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a persistent production schema, and source inspection cannot establish whether SQLite test coverage is accepted as sufficient proof for the deployed D1 upgrade path.

options.title: Require real D1 upgrade proof
options.body: Request a redacted local or hosted Wrangler D1 transcript covering legacy reads, structured append, duplicate replay, conflict handling, and archive output before merge.

options.title: Accept focused SQLite tests
options.body: Treat the existing migration, interruption, concurrency, authentication, and archive tests as sufficient upgrade evidence.
